metrics.profile_summary: Versatile professional with over 10 years of experience across business development, accounting, and customer service. Strong expertise in lead generation, market research, and client relationship management.

experience.role: Freelance Property Consultant & Web Development Researcher
experience.description: Managed residential and commercial property transactions, conducted market research, and generated leads via social media.
Drove business growth through strategic planning, market research, and execution of marketing strategy plans.
Resolved customer complaints and maintained high client satisfaction through product expertise.
Managed financial transactions and trained staff on productivity best practices.
Handled daily call center operations and met tight deadlines.
Managed customer relationships and resolved queries within KPI timeframes.
Prepared bank reconciliations, financial reports, and managed accounts receivable.

strengths: Experience in lead generation and market research
weaknesses: No GA4 or ad platform reporting experience
Lacks 5-7 years of dedicated marketing management
No evidence of managing integrated paid/organic campaigns or marketing budgets
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a generalist with business development and customer service experience but lacks the specialized technical marketing tools (GA4) and the seniority in marketing leadership required for this role.
